title: Design System: Maurice Birchard, Instruction Booklet

display.purpose: Opener titles and the cover headline; 900 italic, uppercase.

chapter-numeral.purpose: Giant tabular chapter number in the opener.

headline.purpose: Section h2s, 800 italic; guide titles, section heads and back cover step to 900.

lede.purpose: One paragraph under each display title, max 60ch.

caption.purpose: Plate and figure captions in soft ink.

label.purpose: Uppercase spec-strip terms only (Role, Engine, Team, Status).

shadows.name: cover-print-drop
shadows.purpose: Cover-art screens only; the single ambient shadow on the site.

shadows.name: leader-halo
shadows.purpose: Keeps leader lines legible over dark screens.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The only easing; used by every transition.

motion.name: leader-draw
motion.value: transform 0.9s var(--ease): scaleX(0) to scaleX(1), once at 35% visibility
motion.purpose: Leader lines draw in once when a Screen Guide enters view; static under reduced motion or without JS.

motion.name: callout-link
motion.value: transform 0.25s var(--ease): disc scale(1.22), pin scale(1.3)
motion.purpose: Linked legend/pin/disc highlight on hover or focus.

motion.name: tab-slide
motion.purpose: Desktop rail tabs slide in on hover, focus and current.

motion.name: cover-print-lift
motion.purpose: Cover-art print straightens and lifts on hover.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: transitions collapse and leader lines are drawn static.

narrative.overview:
The site is printed matter from a 1990s game box: a coated, cool-white booklet in black ink, with a process-blue cover, numbered chapters and coloured thumb tabs cut into the right edge. Every project is a chapter. Each chapter opens on a full-bleed band in its own process colour, then a spec strip, then a Screen Guide: the real UI shown large on a black mat, every element pinned, numbered and explained in a legend beside it. The page carries running heads and folios ("Chapter 02 · page 8") the way a manual does.

Density is manual-like, not gallery-like: text sits in tight, ruled lists separated by 2px ink rules and 1px hairlines, and size carries volume instead of extra families or decoration. One family, Schibsted Grotesk, does everything. Black Italic uppercase is the booklet's shout, used for covers, chapter titles and a few labels. Running text stays regular and sentence case.

Colour is flat, opaque process ink. There are no gradients, glass or glow on site surfaces. Depth is printed, made from ink mats, rules and one soft drop shadow under the cover art. The world explicitly refuses the dark thumbnail grid and the cream editorial portfolio.
keyCharacteristics: Cool coated stock (#EEF1F4 family), never cream; black ink type and rules.
One process colour per chapter, carried by the `--chapter` / `--on-chapter` pair through tabs, openers, discs, list markers, underlines and page-turn links.
Schibsted Grotesk only; Black Italic for volume, regular for reading.
Screen Guide spreads: real screens on an ink mat with pins, hairline leader lines and numbered gutter discs linked to a legend.
Square corners everywhere; the only round shapes are callout discs and pins.
One motion moment: leader lines draw in once when a Screen Guide enters view.

rules.name: The One Chapter Ink Rule
rules.body: A page wears exactly one chapter colour, set once on `body` (or a wrapper) through `--chapter` / `--on-chapter`. Components never hard-code a chapter hex; they read the variable. Tabs and page-turn links set their own chapter class because they point to other chapters.

rules.name: The Cover Owns The Blue Rule
rules.body: Process blue is the cover. It is never a chapter colour and never a section background inside a chapter.

rules.name: The Midas Takes Ink Rule
rules.body: Yellow is the only chapter fill with dark text. Any new chapter colour must hold at least 4.5:1 against its on-colour.

rules.name: The Size Carries Volume Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from size and the 400 to 900 weight jump within one family. Never add a second family to the site.

rules.name: The Black Italic Shout Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is allowed only for: display titles, the wordmark name, home Chapters entry titles, page-turn chapter names, pending-plate titles, and spec-strip terms. Everything else, including h2, h3, body, buttons and captions, stays sentence case.

rules.name: The Tabular Folio Rule
rules.body: Every number that behaves like a page or chapter number (tabs, Contents, chapter numerals, callout discs, dates) uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Printed Depth Rule
rules.body: Nothing lifts off the page except the cover prints. Never use hard offset shadows (solid, unblurred, x/y offset); they belong to a different world. Separate with rules, mats and colour fields.

dos: **Do** set one chapter class per page and let every accent read `--chapter` / `--on-chapter`.
**Do** show real screens on ink mats, and annotate signature screens as a Screen Guide with pins, leader lines, gutter discs and a linked legend.
**Do** use a pending plate ("Screenshot coming soon") when a real capture is missing.
**Do** keep running heads and folios consistent with the Contents page numbers.
**Do** separate content with 2px ink rules and 1px hairlines instead of cards and shadows.
**Do** keep the leader-line draw-in as the only entrance animation, and swap it for a fade under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
**Do** keep claims truthful: roles, engines and status stated exactly. No invented metrics, logos or testimonials.
donts: **Don't** use hard offset shadows or black drop boxes.
**Don't** add eyebrow or kicker labels above headings. The only small uppercase label is the spec-strip term.
**Don't** introduce a second typeface on site surfaces, or uppercase body, h2/h3 or button text.
**Don't** use cream or warm paper as a site background, or a dark thumbnail-grid layout.
**Don't** round corners on anything but discs and pins.
**Don't** use process blue as a chapter colour or a background inside chapters.
**Don't** borrow the Greywater exhibit's fonts, glow or selection bar for the site.
